relations.subject: William Carey
relations.evidence: he founded a Baptist mission station and a printing press, together with Marshman and Ward. Together they started Bible translations (first into Bengali) and other philological work.

relations.subject: William Carey
relations.evidence: In April 1801 Carey was appointed the teacher of Sanskrit and Bengali, from 904 also of Marathi, from 1807 Professor of Sanskrit and Bengali at College of Fort William (Calcutta), taught there until 1830.
